text: Will the incumbent win re-election and will voter turnout exceed 60%?
resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if the incumbent is declared the winner by the state election board, per official results.
note: compound: two clauses joined by "and", and the criteria only cover the first one

text: Will the company's new product be considered a success?
resolution_criteria: Resolves based on general public and critical reception.
note: criteria do not determine the outcome: no named source, threshold, or measurement

text: Will the team win their next game?
resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if the team wins their next game, per the league's official box score.
note: readable two ways: "their next game" does not name an opponent or date, so which game resolves it is ambiguous

text: Will the policy be seen as effective by economists?
resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if a majority of surveyed economists rate the policy effective.
note: criteria do not determine the outcome: no named survey, surveyor, or sample

text: Will the bill pass before the deadline?
resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if the legislature passes the bill before the deadline, per the legislature's official record.
note: readable two ways: "the deadline" is never named

text: Will Bitcoin close above $100,000 on Coinbase at 11:59pm ET on Friday?
resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if Coinbase's BTC-USD closing price at 23:59 ET on Friday is above $100,000, per Coinbase's published closing data.

text: Will the Kansas City Chiefs beat the Buffalo Bills on Sunday, September 13, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if the Chiefs have more points than the Bills at the end of the game, per the NFL's official final score.

text: Will the incumbent be declared the winner of the November 3, 2026 mayoral election?
resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if the city's official election board certifies the incumbent as the winner of the race.

text: Will more than 6 inches of snow be recorded at O'Hare International Airport on December 1, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if the National Weather Service's official snowfall total for O'Hare for that calendar date exceeds 6 inches.

text: Will the film released this weekend gross more than $150 million domestically in its opening weekend?
resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if Box Office Mojo reports a domestic opening-weekend gross above $150 million for the film.

text: Will the central bank raise its benchmark interest rate at its next scheduled meeting on October 15, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if the central bank's official statement from the October 15, 2026 meeting announces an increase to the benchmark rate.
